full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule in a nutshell can be stated thus, the present opposite parties as plaintiffs instituted the original Title Suit being No, 42 of 2002 in the Court of learned Senior. Assistant Judge, Gheor, Manikganj contending inter alia, that the suit land originally belonged to the then Zamindars and during C.S. operation the land was recorded in the name of Zaminder Daraka Nath Chandra. The land being vacant was possessed by the people at large of the locality and after Slate Acquisition and  Tenancy Act, 1950 the land has become 'khash' tinder the government. During S.A. operation it was wrongly recorded in the name of some persons and on the basis of that wrong S.A. record the R.S. khatian being No. 122 was prepared wrongly. The people of the locality from the very beginning do possess the land in dispute. The R.S. and S.A. recorded tenants collusively got their names mutated in Mutation Khatian No. 1/87-88. The names of defendant-respondents in respect of the mutation khatian has been annulled pursuant to a Miscellaneous Case No. 3197 of 1997. The defendants filed a Title Appeal No. 21 of 1997 which was dismissed for default on 12.09.2000. Thereafter, for restoration of the suit a miscellaneous case was preferred which was also rejected but due to denial of plaintiffs title by the defendants the plaintiffs instituted the title suit for declaration of title in respect of the suit land.
